name: lambda-http-proxy
description: AWS Lambda HTTP proxy with response streaming that forwards SigV4-signed requests verbatim

scripts.build: npm run ts:check && npm run build:bundle
scripts.probe:sdk-version: echo 'Deploy a probe to your target region to read the exact runtime SDK version; see lambdaRuntime.sdkVersionProbe'

lambdaRuntime.comment: The @aws-sdk/* and @smithy/* packages are provided by the managed runtime and are marked external in rollup.config.mjs. AWS documents the included SDK version as runtime- AND region-specific; the authoritative source is the deployed runtime itself. Pinned per operator confirmation.
lambdaRuntime.sdkVersionProbe: Deploy a function with: export const handler = async () => ({ version: (await import('@aws-sdk/client-s3/package.json', { with: { type: 'json' } })).default.version }); then invoke it in your target region to confirm.
